# client-probes/probe_primedprint on mp_carentan, 2026-10-20, on retail
# 1.1d, 1.5b and UO 1.51b (`tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_primedprint
# mp_carentan`, PROBE_SECS 25), one plain `vcod --net-probe` client behind a
# UDP relay that dropped the client's sequenced packets for 3 s from the
# first server message over 100 bytes (the gamestate's first fragment), so
# the client sat CS_PRIMED. Each `sent n` queued `self iprintln("pp self
# n")`, `iprintln("pp all n")` and `self setClientCvar("pp_n", n)`. No
# `pp self` or `pp all` print reached the client; every `v pp_n` did,
# pp_0 (queued while connected) inside the gamestate message. Gate:
# connect.rs prints_sent_while_primed_are_dropped_and_cvars_kept.

## 1.1d: server log, then the client
PROBE 3850 connect
PROBE 3850 sent 0
PROBE 4150 sent 1
PROBE 4400 sent 2
PROBE 4650 sent 3
PROBE 4900 sent 4
PROBE 5150 sent 5
PROBE 5400 sent 6
PROBE 5650 sent 7
PROBE 5900 sent 8
PROBE 6150 sent 9
PROBE 6400 sent 10
PROBE 6650 sent 11
PROBE 6900 sent 12
PROBE 6950 begin
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_0", "0"]
gamestate ready: clientNum 0, serverId 16, 116 configstrings, 36 baselines
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_1", "1"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_2", "2"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_3", "3"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_4", "4"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_5", "5"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_6", "6"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_7", "7"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_8", "8"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_9", "9"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_10", "10"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_11", "11"]
serverCommand: ["v", "pp_12", "12"]
serverCommand: ["f", "pp entered"]
